text:
olivia (product): Heads-up: starting a 2-week Legacy Snippet Sweep this Monday (May 12). Goal: remove/replace code snippets that rely on old SDK patterns (callback style, deprecated flags) and add unit tests for snippets. Primary deliverables: (1) checklist & migration guide, (2) automated snippet tests in docs CI, (3) compat shim plan for customers needing extra time. Please read the plan: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/sweeps/legacy-snippet-sweep

kevin (eng-docs): Thanks — will open the docs repo epic and label PRs. What's the strict cutoff for removal? :thinking:

olivia (product): No immediate breaking removals. Timeline: sweep = doc edits + tests; deprecation notices go live in 30 days; hard removal of legacy snippets in 90 days. We'll provide compat shims for Hosted API for 6 months.

ajay (eng): For SDK consumers, we should add a feature flag and a `compat` param. Eng can add a minor patch release to route old calls. I'll draft a PR for the python/js clients.

sophia (dev-rel): I'll coordinate emails + changelog banner and a migration cheat-sheet. Can we get a sample migration matrix? I can help compile.

taylor (legal): quick check: ensure we don't remove any snippets tied to customer contracts. I'll review the list.

docs-bot: Ran snippet-linter on `main` — 42 warnings, 11 errors. See https://ci.redwood.ai/annotate/2305011111

kevin (eng-docs): I'll triage the 11 errors this afternoon. Suggest we set docs CI to fail on errors after the first week.

ajay (eng): FYI: adding a compat flag will require a minor semver bump; won't break existing installs.

sophia (dev-rel): Proposed outreach timeline: announcement + migration guide (week1), webinars + office hours (week2), migration checklist + sample PRs (week3).

olivia (product): Thanks all. Action items: @kevin open epic + label; @ajay PR for compat shim; @sophia migration assets; @taylor legal review. Ping here with blockers. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: docs-ci run queued for `legacy-snippet-sweep` branch — ETA ~30m

kevin (eng-docs): created epic: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REDWX-9999 — added initial issues

ajay (eng): draft PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 — uses `compat_mode=true`

sophia (dev-rel): uploaded draft migration guide to /docs/drafts/legacy-snippets.md — feedback welcome

olivia (product): Great progress. We'll review status at next weekly docs sync. End of thread.
